title: One line of the farmer's message board (board.jsonl)
description: A message the farmer sent, the ack it got and a note (hal2 plan 0290 step 3, D23; scripts/board.py, the tollman's board of the same form, `--role farmer`): `slot` is the field the line concerns (the receiving or answering one), `from` and `to` are field names as the queue has them (`09`, `farmer-hal2`), `-` where no single field is meant, never a pane id, session id or title.

at.description: RFC 3339 UTC with Z and whole seconds.

text.description: A message's stamped text; an ack's note; a note's whole content.

id.description: A message's ack id (`<slot>-<n>`); an ack line carries the id of the message it answers.

status.description: An ack's word: started, done or refused.
